C-SAFETY-GATE-MODEL-REVIEW.Name: Restore the two-model safety review and sanitize the leaked public surfaces — implementation plan
C-SAFETY-GATE-MODEL-REVIEW.IntentSummary: Bring back the exact-candidate model review that gate 1.9.0 removed, as two independent reviewers: two serial local passes plus one non-local (kari/Tailscale) pass per chunk, resolved from owner-local configuration outside the repository or environment variables, fail-closed with the explicit human override. Widen the deterministic checks to private-companion and owner-workspace paths without blocking synthetic examples. Sanitize every public surface that leaked private paths, including released ledgers, frozen plans and archived bundles, and record the audit. Update M-064/V-M-064 and the commit/push safety document, then reinstall the hooks.

MustContain.Text: Every local commit and push must pass
two serial local passes and one independent non-local pass
two serial local model passes and one independent non-local pass
two serial owner-local model passes and one independent non-local pass

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The spec records the owner approval and the three mode choices; the plan passes the change-plan schema; both files lint with zero errors.

T-002.Title: Reviewer layer: local two-pass, non-local pass, private configuration, fail-closed override

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: reviewer_config resolves endpoints/models from environment or the private reviewers.json, requires the non-local endpoint, enforces loopback for local and private/CGNAT/ts.net for non-local, and rejects redirects. local_review performs two serial passes per chunk; non_local_review performs one; review() validates every verdict, rechecks identity and writes a receipt naming both reviewers. The override path is restored with its identity-bound receipt and marker.

T-003.Title: Deterministic private-reference rules and synthetic-example allowances

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Full blobs and the message/diff text reject owner-workspace paths, bare private companion/worktree/media/tooling names, CGNAT and ts.net addresses and non-generic absolute home users; `/Users/<fixture>/`, `/Users/<user>/`, `/Users/me/`, `/Users/dev/`, `/Users/x/`, `~/project`, `~/Library/...` and the existing fixture corpus pass. A direct probe of the four leaked files blocks each one.

Every private reference found by the audit is replaced with a neutral placeholder in the listed files, including the released 2.8.x ledger, frozen plans, the migration record, archived bundles and the publication-privacy regression; a repeat scan reports zero unexpected hits and the audit report is written to private storage.

T-005.Title: GRACE anchors, safety document and final gates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: M-064 and V-M-064 describe the two-reviewer contract and the widened deterministic boundary; docs/commit-push-safety.md documents both reviewers, the private configuration, the private-network restriction and the override; the security and publication suites and grace lint are green.

The shared hooks execute the new gate from the common Git safety directory; the private reviewers.json exists with owner-configured endpoints and is mode 0600 outside the repository; an install/commit reports the two-reviewer pass marker or the explicit override marker.

Gates.Gate: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/security -p 'test_*.py' — all safety gate cases pass.
npx vitest run tests/renderer/publication-privacy.test.js tests/renderer/release-readiness.test.js tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js — privacy and train contracts pass.
grace status --path . --with modules --json — healthy before handoff.
